items.raw_excerpt: Long queues formed at Keflavík International Airport this morning, with lines extending outside the terminal for the second time in recent days. The longest waiting time was estimated at around 45 minutes. According to Guðjón Helgason, communications officer for airport operator Isavia, the congestion is linked to the large number of visitors who travelled to…
items.summary_en: Long queues formed at Keflavik International Airport this morning. Lines stretched outside the terminal for the second time in recent days, and the longest wait was about 45 minutes. The crowding is linked to the many visitors who came to Iceland for the eclipse.
items.summary_ko: 오늘 아침 케플라빅 국제공항에 긴 줄이 생겼다. 최근 며칠 사이 두 번째로 줄이 터미널 밖까지 늘어섰고, 가장 오래 기다린 시간은 약 45분으로 추산됐다. 개기일식을 보러 온 많은 방문객이 원인으로 꼽힌다.
items.title_en: Eclipse Exodus: Long Queues Again at Keflavik Airport
items.title_ko: 개기일식 뒤 케플라빅 공항에 다시 긴 줄
items.title_original: Eclipse Exodus: Long Queues Return at Keflavík Airport

items.raw_excerpt: Los fanáticos se expresaron de inmediato a las 00:00 horas de este 15 de agosto.
items.summary_en: Fans of Santiago Wanderers celebrated the club's 134th anniversary with fireworks right at midnight on August 15. Supporters came together to set off fireworks for the special day. Videos of the celebration were shared online.
items.summary_ko: 산티아고 원더러스 팬들이 8월 15일 자정에 맞춰 구단 창단 134주년을 폭죽으로 축하했다. 팬들은 특별한 날을 기념하기 위해 모여 불꽃놀이를 터뜨렸다. 축하 현장의 영상이 온라인에 공유됐다.
items.title_en: Videos: Fans celebrated Santiago Wanderers' 134 years with fireworks

items.raw_excerpt: Harrisons Malayalam employs drone seeding to restore 15 acres of eucalyptus land in Idukki, enhancing biodiversity with 24 native species.
items.summary_en: A plantation company used drones to drop seeds on 15 acres of old eucalyptus land in Idukki, Kerala. The project aims to bring back 24 native plant species and improve biodiversity in the area.
items.summary_ko: 플랜테이션 회사가 인도 케랄라주 이두키의 옛 유칼립투스 땅 15에이커에 드론으로 씨앗을 뿌렸습니다. 이 프로젝트는 현지 토종 식물 24종을 되살리고 지역의 생물 다양성을 높이는 것이 목표입니다.
items.title_en: Drones plant seeds to restore 15 acres of eucalyptus land in Idukki

items.title_original: HML uses drone seeding to restore 15 acres of eucalyptus land in Idukki

items.summary_en: Stamp collecting used to be a popular hobby among Singapore schoolchildren. Today, fewer people are drawn to its slow pleasures in the fast digital age. But 25-year-old Sim Jen Lun has been collecting stamps since 2015 and keeps the hobby alive.
items.summary_ko: 우표 수집은 한때 싱가포르 학생들 사이에서 인기 있는 취미였습니다. 빠르게 돌아가는 디지털 시대에 이제는 그 느긋한 즐거움에 끌리는 사람이 줄었습니다. 하지만 25세 심진룬 씨는 2015년부터 우표를 모으며 이 취미를 이어가고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Singapore's young stamp collectors keep the 'king of hobbies' alive

items.title_original: Can Singapore's young stamp collectors keep the 'king of hobbies' alive?

items.raw_excerpt: Mr Tan Chun Lim, 81, owns and runs the last "pure stamp shop" in Singapore. With 70 years of stamp collecting and dealing under his belt, he shares with CNA TODAY his fondest memories of what used to be a wildly popular hobby – and what's next for his dwindling trade.
items.summary_en: Mr Tan Chun Lim, 81, owns and runs the last pure stamp shop in Singapore. He has collected and dealt stamps for 70 years. He shares his fondest memories of this hobby and what is next for his shrinking trade.
items.summary_ko: 81살의 탄춘림 씨는 싱가포르에서 마지막 남은 순수 우표 가게를 운영하고 있습니다. 그는 70년 동안 우표를 수집하고 거래해 왔습니다. 한때 크게 유행했던 취미에 대한 가장 좋은 기억과, 점점 줄어드는 그의 장사가 앞으로 어떻게 될지 이야기를 들려줍니다.
items.title_en: An 81-year-old man runs the last stamp shop in Singapore
items.title_ko: 81살 할아버지가 운영하는 싱가포르의 마지막 우표 가게
items.title_original: 'Stamps are in my blood': How this 81-year-old stamp dealer keeps the trade alive

items.raw_excerpt: A loggerhead turtle attempted to nest on Cotobro beach in Almuñécar, prompting authorities to monitor the area in case it returns.
items.summary_en: A loggerhead turtle tried to nest on Cotobro beach in Almuñécar, Spain. Local authorities are watching the area in case the turtle returns.

items.title_en: Loggerhead turtle tries to nest on beach

items.raw_excerpt: Affected communities say the stench is the most unbearable and affects respiratory health
items.summary_en: Communities in South Africa's North West province say the sewage smell is unbearable. The smell hurts their breathing and health. A human rights body has warned about the crisis.

items.summary_en: A couple ended up buying a landmark house called The Ark in Otago after a spontaneous drive. The house has a history linked to the movie 'Sliding Doors'. It now has a 'for sale' sign on it.

items.raw_excerpt: Empreendimento na Quadra 60 receberá investimento de R$ 22,5 milhões e integra a etapa final do projeto de habitação popular da área
items.summary_en: A new housing project will be built in the Pilar community in Recife, Brazil. The project will receive about 22.5 million reais and add 128 apartments. It is the final stage of the area's popular housing plan.
items.summary_ko: 브라질 헤시피의 필라르 지역에 새 주택 단지가 지어진다. 이 사업에는 약 2250만 헤알이 투자되며 아파트 128채가 들어선다. 지역 주민을 위한 서민 주택 사업의 마지막 단계다.
items.title_en: Pilar community gets new housing project with 128 apartments
